newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain EconMin welcomes BoS interest rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Spain EconMin welcomes BoS interest rate cut.

text.p: Spain's Economy Ministry welcomed on Friday the central bank's 50 basis point cut in its key money rate to 6.25 percent, saying it would help create employment.
"This cut implies a new reduction in financial costs for Spanish companies and benefits the domestic economy," a statement said.
"It will also make consumption and investment decisions cheaper, favouring the creation of employment," it added.
The ministry said inflation data, released minutes before the cut was announced, had also been very positive.
The November Consumer Price Index (CPI) was unchanged after a 0.1 percent rise in October. Year-on-year, it rose 3.2 percent compared with a 3.5 percent rise in October.
The ministry said the trend in these variables would help the government move closer to achieving its goals for entry into Europe's economic and monetary union.
